name: Tarrabah

frame.name: Ravenous Beast
frame.description:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage; defeating combatants or dealing damage to Scorched combatants grants increased progress.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Unleashes the beast when full, increasing outgoing damage and reducing incoming Solar damage.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Bottomless Appetite
perks.description: Dealing continuous damage extends the duration of Ravenous Beast.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: We walk where our ancestors once walked.

catalyst.name: Tarrabah Catalyst
catalyst.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.
